status: FROZEN — thresholds set BEFORE any backtest result. Changing any value is a NEW pre-registration and re-incurs the divide-by-N haircut.
control: RAW = current screener output (engine_top5 + curated, unchanged).
treatment: ENHANCED = RAW + the gating/ranking stack below.

haircut.rule: in-sample edge divided by N before any 'survives' claim

anti_look_ahead: Every filter reads bars[0..signal_index] only; proven by truncation test in enhanced_filters.py self-test.
measurement: Tag each FORWARD pick RAW-pass vs ENHANCED-pass going forward; expectancy-led; FORWARD never blended with HISTORICAL; n>=30 before 'validated'.

filters.name: trend_template
filters.rule: close > SMA50 > SMA150 > SMA200, SMA50 and SMA200 both rising over 21 bars; >=30% above 52w low; within 25% of 52w high
filters.prior_status: PARTIAL — exists as soft 0-100% score, not a hard gate

filters.name: vcp
filters.rule: >=2 successive pullbacks, each <=0.75x the prior depth, with pivot volume <=0.85x base volume; whole base <=35% deep

filters.name: volume_breakout
filters.rule: breakout/entry bar volume >= 1.40x the trailing 50-bar average (prior bars only)

filters.name: rs_rank
filters.rule: rank survivors by 126-bar return minus SPY; keep top decile (top 10%)

filters.name: not_extended
filters.rule: reject if >5*ATR(14) above pivot, OR >12% above SMA50, OR RSI(14) >= 80
filters.prior_status: PARTIAL — pullback entry exists but extended names not rejected
filters.forward_evidence: EXISTS — at_market vs pullback_limit forward split already validates this (see raw_vs_enhanced.md)

filters.name: earnings_growth
filters.prior_status: MISSING — needs fundamentals feed; NOT computable from OHLCV; flagged deferred, not fabricated

enhanced_pass_definition: all GATES pass (trend_template, not_extended, liquidity, volume_breakout); VCP + RS_rank inform ranking; earnings_growth deferred (None never counts as a pass)
ship_rule: promote a filter to live ONLY if ENHANCED beats RAW on FORWARD expectancy after the /N haircut, at n>=30 ENHANCED-pass forward picks. Otherwise ship nothing; log null.
